title: closeafter=state ignores live event when only ping in replay
description: When closeafter=state is used with ?ping=N and no Last-Event-ID, the ping event is pushed into replay_events making replay_count=1. The fix sets live_limit=0 when replay_count>0, so take(replay_count+live_limit)=take(1) closes the stream after delivering only the ping event. The client never receives a state event, defeating the purpose of closeafter=state.
